section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants for Study X, initially consisting of 200 women recruited from a private university in Ribeirão Preto, Brazil. After excluding six participants, the final sample comprised 194 women with a mean age of 21.80 years and a mean BMI of 23.99 kg/m2. The majority (88.7%) of the sample self-reported as ethnically White.
